out_items.name: Person in charge present, demonstrates knowledge, and performs duties

violations.title: PIC Duties, Train Employees on No Bare Hand Contact
violations.observation: Employees are not aware of or are not using suitable utensils with ready-to-eat food to prevent cross-contamination. Observed employee organizing 2 dr prep cooler and touching food directly with bare hands.
violations.corrective_action: The Person in Charge or certified food manager shall be ensuring his/her employees are using suitable utensils such as deli tissue, tongs, spatulas, or disposable gloves to handle ready-to-eat foods to prevent bare hand contact. EHS provided training.

violations.title: PIC Duties, Train Employees on Cleaning and Sanitizing
violations.observation: Employees are not properly sanitizing cleaned multiuse equipment and utensils before they are reused. Observed sanitizer at 10 ppm and improper 3-compartment sink set up.
violations.corrective_action: The Person in Charge or certified food manager shall train his/her employees to properly sanitize all equipment, utensils, and surfaces after being cleaned using either an approved sanitizer at the adequate concentration or heat sanitization at the proper temperature to destroy pathogenic bacteria. EHS provided in person training on how to set up 3 compartment sink and how to properly wash, rinse and sanitize utensils.

out_items.name: Hands clean and properly washed

violations.title: Cleaning Procedure
violations.observation: Observed food employees using improper handwashing procedures. Observed employee washing her hands without applying soap.
violations.corrective_action: Food employees shall wash their hands and exposed portions of their arms by: 1) discarding used gloves; 2) rinsing under warm running water; 3) applying soap; 4) rubbing together for at least 10-15 seconds; 5) rinsing thoroughly under warm running water; and 6) drying with paper towels or air drying device.EHS provided training.

out_items.name: Food separated and protected

violations.title: Separation of Raw Animal and RTE Foods
violations.observation: Raw animal food storage, preparation, holding or display conducted in a manner that may cause cross contamination of ready-to-eat food as follows: Observed raw chicken on top of raw vegetables and corn drinks.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from cross contamination by separating raw animal foods like poultry, beef, pork, seafood, and eggs from cooked foods, ready-to- eat foods, washed produce, etc during storage, preparation, holding or display. Raw foods shall be stored on shelving units BELOW or SEPARATED from all cooked foods, commercially processed foods, washed produce, leftover foods, etc. CFM discarded raw chicken at 45F.

out_items.name: Food-contact surfaces cleaned and sanitized

violations.title: Chemical Sanitization, Chlorine Requirements
violations.observation: When tested, the chlorine-based sanitizing solution was observed to be at a concentration less than what is required for effective sanitization of food-contact surfaces of equipment and utensils. Observed the sanitizing solution in the 3-compartment sink with a concentration of 10 ppm total chlorine.
violations.corrective_action: A chlorine-based sanitizing solution shall have a minimum concentration of at least 50 to 200 ppm total chlorine when tested using the appropriate test kit. Employee add more chlorine to reach 100 ppm.

violations.title: RTE TCS Food Prepared On Site, Date Marking
violations.observation: The following refrigerated, ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety food that is prepared on site is not used or discarded within 24 hours of preparation and was not observed to be date marked: Observed milk corn drink, cooked chicken, shredded cabbage in unit # 3 without date

out_items.name: Approved thawing methods used

violations.title: Proper thawing methods used for TCS Foods
violations.observation: Observed the following food thawing using an improper method: OBSERVED TWO TURKEYS THAWING AT ROOM TEMPERATURE ON A COUNTER.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be thawed using one of the following methods: 1) under refrigeration that maintains the food temperature at 41F or less, 2) completely submerged under running water at a water temperature of 70F or below with a sufficient velocity to agitate and float off loose particles of food as long as held for period of time at a temperature of 41F or less, or 3) as part of a cooking process if the food is cooked as specified by Law or thawed in a microwave oven and immediately transferred to a conventional cooking process. CDI: TURKEYS MOVED TO WALK-IN COOLER.

violations.title: Controlling Pests, Pest Control Methods
violations.observation: Methods are not being used to control pests. out_items.name: Proper cooling methods used; adequate equipment for temperature control

violations.title: Methods to Facilitate Proper Cooling
violations.observation: The following methods used for cooling were not adequate to facilitate proper cooling: OBSERVED TAMALES STACKED TIGHTLY AND HIGH IN A CONTAINER TO COOL OVERNIGHT.
violations.corrective_action: Cooling hot foods shall be accomplished as follows: 1) placing the food in shallow pans; 2) separating the food into smaller or thinner portions; 3) using rapid cooling equipment; 4) stirring the food in a container placed in an ice water bath; 5) using containers that facilitate heat transfer; 6) adding ice as an ingredient; or other effective methods. Food containers placed in cooling and cold equipment to cool shall be: 1) arranged in the equipment to provide maximum heat transfer through the containers walls, and 2) loosely covered or uncovered as long as protected from contamination to facilitate heat transfer from the surface of the food. CDI: PIC RE-EDUCATED. UTILIZE THE METHODS STATED ABOVE TO COOL TCS ITEMS SUCH AS TAMALES. DO NOT STACK THEM TO COOL AS THEY WILL NOT COOL.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following refrigeration unit is not operating properly and is unable to maintain cold food at or below 41F: OBSERVED 3-DOOR PREP-TOP COOLER MAINTAINING FOOD AT 45F-50F.
violations.corrective_action: Repair/adjust the unit so it is able to maintain foods at or below 41F. Do not use the unit to store time/temperature control for safety foods while it is not operating properly. FOODS MOVED TO WALK-IN COOLER. CEASE USING THIS UNIT UNTIL IT IS REPAIRED TO HOLD FOOD AT OR UNDER 41F. PLEASE SEND INVOICE TO EHS WITHIN 10 DAYS.

violations.title: Food-Contact Surfaces, Weight and Thickness
violations.observation: The food-contact surfaces of the following equipment and/or utensils are not sufficient in weight and thickness: OBSERVED TRASH BAGS COVERING BAKED FOODS IN FREEZER AND WALK-IN COOLER.
violations.corrective_action: Materials that are used in the construction of utensils and food-contact surfaces of equipment may not allow the migration of deleterious substances or impart colors, odors, or tastes to food and under normal use conditions shall be sufficient in weight and thickness to withstand repeated warewashing. CEASE USING TRASH BAGS IMMEDIATELY AND REPLACE WITH NSF-APPROVED COVERING.

out_items.name: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean

violations.title: Physical Facilities, Cleaning Frequency
violations.observation: OBSERVED MOUSE DROPPINGS, GRIME, AND BUILDUP THROUGHOUT FACILITY INCLUDING DRY STORAGE AND ON FLOOR.
violations.corrective_action: Clean the physical facilities at a frequency necessary to ensure the protection and safe preparation of food. FACILITY MUST BE CLEANED THOROUGHLY TO RID IT OF GRIME, BUILDUP, AND MOUSE DROPPINGS.

out_items.name: Certified Food Protection Manager

violations.title: Food Protection Manager - Accredited Program
violations.observation: It shall be unlawful to operate a food establishment unless it is under the immediate control of a certified food manager who has shown proficiency through passing an accredited examination. CFM WAS NOT PRESENT AT THE TIME OF INSPECTION.
violations.corrective_action: Obtain a certified food managers certificate from an accredited program. EHS WILL FOLLOW UP ON OR AROUND 12/20 TO ENSURE A CFM IS PRESENT.

out_items.name: Proper hot holding temperatures

violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed hot holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: plantains 113F, cheese empanada 120F
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature conrol for safety food shall be held hot at a temperature of 135F or above unless the permit holder is using 'time as the public health control' as specified under 3-501.19. PIC DISCARDED FOOD.

out_items.name: Insects, rodents, and animals not present

violations.observation: Methods are not being used to control pests. OBSERVED TWO LIVE COCKROACHES IN THE FACILITY.
violations.corrective_action: Insects and other pests are capable of transmitting disease to people by contaminating food and food-contact surfaces.
